subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “The town, once thought to be unimportant in history, had been part of a wider network.”?
options: Students were surprised that such an ordinary object was in a museum.
From there, students saw the sea, harbor, and town together.
Students visited the museum and saw the coin under bright light.
For history class, students created a small museum in their classroom.

本文沒有陳述「From there, students saw the sea, harbor, and town together.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「The town, once thought to be unimportant in history, had been part of a wider network. Students visited the museum and saw…」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The town, once thought to be unimportant in history, had been part of a wider network. Students visited the museum and saw the coin…」，答案為「Students visited the museum and saw the coin under bright light.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Students visited the museum and saw the coin under bright light.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
